title: Order state
description: The published list of states an order, or one part of an order, can be in (REQ-STM-1, REQ-STM-2). Every state of REQ-STM-2's table is here, the handed-on order included. A part with no route left becomes stuck if its value can't be routed to the node where the destination reserve lives (REQ-ORD-28), and waits for the customer if its value is already at that node after a failed final deposit (REQ-ORD-43); the owner's ruling spec-no-route-left.
